text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Businessmen and investors in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia plan to set up a 100-million-dinar tourism company in Bahrain.
- Bahrain to participate in Cairo's economic summit.
- Prime Minister Sheikh Khalifa says Bahrain is capable of overcoming difficulties and conspiracies.
- Housing minister says Bahrain to witness development in construction in next few years.
- Bahrain to host major management forum next month.
- British Bank of the Middle East changes its marketing name to "BritishBank".
